paragraphs.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
paragraphs.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ κατʼ ἐπαγγελίαν ζωῆς τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
paragraphs.translit: Paulos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos theou katʼ epangelian zōēs tēs en Christō Iēsou

paragraphs.text: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
paragraphs.original: Τιμοθέῳ ἀγαπητῷ τέκνῳ· χάρις, ἔλεος, εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Timotheō agapētō teknō· charis, eleos, eirēnē apo theou patros kai Christou Iēsou tou kyriou hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers in a pure conscience, how unceasing is my remembrance of thee in my supplications, night and day
paragraphs.original: Χάριν ἔχω τῷ θεῷ, ᾧ λατρεύω ἀπὸ προγόνων ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, ὡς ἀδιάλειπτον ἔχω τὴν περὶ σοῦ μνείαν ἐν ταῖς δεήσεσίν μου, νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας
paragraphs.translit: Charin echō tō theō, hō latreuō apo progonōn en kathara syneidēsei, hōs adialeipton echō tēn peri sou mneian en tais deēsesin mou, nyktos kai hēmeras

paragraphs.text: longing to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
paragraphs.original: ἐπιποθῶν σε ἰδεῖν, μεμνημένος σου τῶν δακρύων, ἵνα χαρᾶς πληρωθῶ
paragraphs.translit: epipothōn se idein, memnēmenos sou tōn dakryōn, hina charas plērōthō

paragraphs.text: having been reminded of the unfeigned faith that is in thee; which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and, I am persuaded, in thee also.
paragraphs.original: ὑπόμνησιν λαβὼν τῆς ἐν σοὶ ἀνυποκρίτου πίστεως, ἥτις ἐνῴκησεν πρῶτον ἐν τῇ μάμμῃ σου Λωΐδι καὶ τῇ μητρί σου Εὐνίκῃ, πέπεισμαι δὲ ὅτι καὶ ἐν σοί.
paragraphs.translit: hypomnēsin labōn tēs en soi anypokritou pisteōs, hētis enōkēsen prōton en tē mammē sou Lōidi kai tē mētri sou Eunikē, pepeismai de hoti kai en soi.

paragraphs.text: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee through the laying on of my hands.
paragraphs.original: διʼ ἣν αἰτίαν ἀναμιμνῄσκω σε ἀναζωπυρεῖν τὸ χάρισμα τοῦ θεοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν σοὶ διὰ τῆς ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν μου·
paragraphs.translit: diʼ hēn aitian anamimnēskō se anazōpyrein to charisma tou theou, ho estin en soi dia tēs epitheseōs tōn cheirōn mou·

paragraphs.text: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ θεὸς πνεῦμα δειλίας, ἀλλὰ δυνάμεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ σωφρονισμοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ou gar edōken hēmin ho theos pneuma deilias, alla dynameōs kai agapēs kai sōphronismou.

paragraphs.text: Be not ashamed therefore of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but suffer hardship with the gospel according to the power of God;
paragraphs.original: Μὴ οὖν ἐπαισχυνθῇς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μηδὲ ἐμὲ τὸν δέσμιον αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ συγκακοπάθησον τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ κατὰ δύναμιν θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Mē oun epaischynthēs to martyrion tou kyriou hēmōn mēde eme ton desmion autou, alla synkakopathēson tō euangeliō kata dynamin theou,

paragraphs.text: who saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ σώσαντος ἡμᾶς καὶ καλέσαντος κλήσει ἁγίᾳ, οὐ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἰδίαν πρόθεσιν καὶ χάριν, τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων,
paragraphs.translit: tou sōsantos hēmas kai kalesantos klēsei hagia, ou kata ta erga hēmōn alla kata idian prothesin kai charin, tēn dotheisan hēmin en Christō Iēsou pro chronōn aiōniōn,

paragraphs.text: but hath now been manifested by the appearing of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,
paragraphs.original: φανερωθεῖσαν δὲ νῦν διὰ τῆς ἐπιφανείας τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, καταργήσαντος μὲν τὸν θάνατον φωτίσαντος δὲ ζωὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,
paragraphs.translit: phanerōtheisan de nyn dia tēs epiphaneias tou sōtēros hēmōn Iēsou Christou, katargēsantos men ton thanaton phōtisantos de zōēn kai aphtharsian dia tou euangeliou,

paragraphs.text: whereunto I was appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher.
paragraphs.original: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος καὶ διδάσκαλος.
paragraphs.translit: eis ho etethēn egō kēryx kai apostolos kai didaskalos.

paragraphs.text: For which cause I suffer also these things: yet I am not ashamed; for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed unto him against that day.
paragraphs.original: διʼ ἣν αἰτίαν καὶ ταῦτα πάσχω, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἐπαισχύνομαι, οἶδα γὰρ ᾧ πεπίστευκα, καὶ πέπεισμαι ὅτι δυνατός ἐστιν τὴν παραθήκην μου φυλάξαι εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν ἡμέραν.
paragraphs.translit: diʼ hēn aitian kai tauta paschō, allʼ ouk epaischynomai, oida gar hō pepisteuka, kai pepeismai hoti dynatos estin tēn parathēkēn mou phylaxai eis ekeinēn tēn hēmeran.

paragraphs.text: Hold the pattern of sound words which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: ὑποτύπωσιν ἔχε ὑγιαινόντων λόγων ὧν παρʼ ἐμοῦ ἤκουσας ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: hypotypōsin eche hygiainontōn logōn hōn parʼ emou ēkousas en pistei kai agapē tē en Christō Iēsou·

paragraphs.text: That good thing which was committed unto [thee] guard through the Holy Spirit which dwelleth in us.
paragraphs.original: τὴν καλὴν παραθήκην φύλαξον διὰ πνεύματος ἁγίου τοῦ ἐνοικοῦντος ἐν ἡμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: tēn kalēn parathēkēn phylaxon dia pneumatos hagiou tou enoikountos en hēmin.

paragraphs.text: This thou knowest, that all that are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
paragraphs.original: Οἶδας τοῦτο ὅτι ἀπεστράφησάν με πάντες οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ, ὧν ἐστιν Φύγελος καὶ Ἑρμογένης.
paragraphs.translit: Oidas touto hoti apestraphēsan me pantes hoi en tē Asia, hōn estin Phygelos kai Hermogenēs.

paragraphs.text: The Lord grant mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus: for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;
paragraphs.original: δῴη ἔλεος ὁ κύριος τῷ Ὀνησιφόρου οἴκῳ, ὅτι πολλάκις με ἀνέψυξεν, καὶ τὴν ἅλυσίν μου οὐκ ἐπαισχύνθη·
paragraphs.translit: dōē eleos ho kyrios tō Onēsiphorou oikō, hoti pollakis me anepsyxen, kai tēn halysin mou ouk epaischynthē·

paragraphs.text: but, when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ γενόμενος ἐν Ῥώμῃ σπουδαίως ἐζήτησέν με καὶ εὗρεν—
paragraphs.translit: alla genomenos en Rhōmē spoudaiōs ezētēsen me kai heuren—

paragraphs.text: (the Lord grant unto him to find mercy of the Lord in that day); and in how many things he ministered at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
paragraphs.original: δῴη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος εὑρεῖν ἔλεος παρὰ κυρίου ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ— καὶ ὅσα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ διηκόνησεν, βέλτιον σὺ γινώσκεις.
paragraphs.translit: dōē autō ho kyrios heurein eleos para kyriou en ekeinē tē hēmera— kai hosa en Ephesō diēkonēsen, beltion sy ginōskeis.
